title: Clive University multi-page topic-bounded AI study coach
approval_source: Current Slack instruction: make it happen; restrict information to CliveUni topics; no personal information or secrets; split into several pages; deep test; deploy an impressive experience.

acceptance_criteria.AC-1: Clive University provides distinct, directly addressable pages for Today, Learn, Stories, Field, and Library plus directly addressable topic pages for each approved course, article, case study, and location lab.
acceptance_criteria.AC-2: Every approved topic page exposes a responsive Study with AI experience that automatically binds to that exact server-registered topic ID.
acceptance_criteria.AC-3: The tutor API accepts only a bounded topic ID, bounded conversation messages, and a fixed coaching mode; it rejects unknown fields, unknown topic IDs, client-supplied context, URLs, files, system prompts, model names, tools, and provider parameters.
acceptance_criteria.AC-4: Server context is built exclusively from a committed, public-safe, generated allowlist derived from CliveUni courses, articles, case studies, and field-guide bundles; the API has no filesystem browsing, transcript, GBrain, employee-system, web-search, or arbitrary retrieval capability.
acceptance_criteria.AC-5: The tutor answers only from the active topic context, uses topic citations when available, distinguishes evidence from application suggestions, and gives a narrow redirect for unrelated or insufficiently grounded requests.
acceptance_criteria.AC-6: Prompt-injection, system-prompt extraction, secret/key/password requests, personal-data requests, unrelated/general-knowledge questions, encoded/Unicode bypasses, and cross-topic attempts fail closed without echoing sensitive input.
acceptance_criteria.AC-7: No provider credential or service secret is present in public bundles, client JavaScript, source-controlled config, test fixtures, logs, errors, or responses; provider credentials are read only from server environment at runtime.
acceptance_criteria.AC-8: The API retains no conversation history, sets no tracking cookie, emits no message-body logs, limits request size/message count/output size, enforces exact production/local CORS allowlists, and applies bounded rate limiting.
acceptance_criteria.AC-9: If the provider is unavailable or unconfigured, the API returns a generic bounded unavailable response and never falls back to browser credentials, unrelated credentials, or general internet knowledge.
acceptance_criteria.AC-10: Desktop and 390px mobile browsing, chat open/send/reset, keyboard navigation, focus behavior, loading/error/refusal/success states, and no-horizontal-overflow are browser verified with zero uncaught console errors.
acceptance_criteria.AC-11: Automated tests cover topic generation, route integrity, schema rejection, CORS, rate limits, no-retention, injection/exfiltration/refusal matrices, provider context construction, output grounding checks, and public forbidden-content scans.
acceptance_criteria.AC-12: Production pages and tutor endpoint are independently read back after deployment; a safe in-topic question succeeds and synthetic adversarial probes deny without leaking internal context or credentials.

non_goals.NG-1: Do not publish or expose raw DSP transcripts, the private DSP corpus, GBrain data, repository files, local files, credentials, environment values, or hidden prompts.
non_goals.NG-2: Do not collect employee identity, email, location assignment, HR data, guest data, financial records, or personal profiles.
non_goals.NG-3: Do not provide open-domain assistance, web search, personal advice, legal/HR decisions, adopted-policy claims, or autonomous operational mutations.
non_goals.NG-4: Do not change unrelated ai-lava.com routes, DNS, billing plans, production databases, Clive operating systems, or private knowledge systems.
non_goals.NG-5: Do not reuse credentials from unrelated applications or commit any credential value.
